items.content: This Lease Agreement made the 2025-12-3, by and between Mrs. Patti Fay MD [name of lessor], of 51323 unique village [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as “Lessor”, and Weimann Inc [name of lessee], of 84784 Godfrey Grove [street address], State of California, hereinafter referred to as “Lessee”, collectively referred to herein as the “Parties”, agree as follows:
The Lessor agrees to lease to the Lessee the following described 1543 square feet (SF) of warehouse located at 52577 Hailey Corners [street address], State of California.
The term of this Lease shall be for a period of 4 year(s) 2 month(s) commencing on the 31 day of December 2025, and expiring at Midnight on the 3 day of March 2030 day of March 2030 (“Initial Term”)

The net monthly payment shall be 9750 dollars ($9750) per month. A security deposit of 2317 dollars ($2317) is required, payable monthly with the first payment due upon the is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the commencement of the Lease and each monthly installment payable thereafter on the 1st day of each month
Lessee may not renew the Lease.

The Lessee may have the right to renew the Lease with a total of renewal period(s) with each term being year(s) month(s) which may be exercised by giving written notice to Lessor no less than 60 days prior to the expiration of the Lease or renewal period.
